主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada announced the availability of Q4 2013 supplementary financial information reflecting the adoption of amendments to International Accounting Standard 19 Employee Benefits, as well as the adoption of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) 10 Consolidated Financial Statements and IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements. These standards became effective for RBC on November 1, 2013. The financial information reflects the impact of these standards on consolidated comparative financial results for 2013 and 2012. RBC will release first quarter 2014 results and host an earnings conference call on February 26, 2014.
